tei:div.tei:p: gzhi rnam dag lam dus kyi lam dus kyi rnam dag 'bras bu rnam dag

oṃ gzhi'i rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal pa/oṃ dag bya/kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa/ oṃdag byed/ skye ba dang 'gag pa med pa/ oṃthob bya/ dpal he ru ka chen po/ hrīḥ gzhi'i rang byung gi snying po nyid/ hrīḥ dag bya/nyon mongs pa can gyi yid/ hrīḥdag byed/ de bzhin 'od gsal ba/ hrīḥthob bya/ rdo rje rnam 'byor ma/ ha gzhi'i bya ba dang byed pa'i tshogs dang bral ba/ha dag bya/yid kyi rnam par shes pa/ hadag byed/ gzhan ma yin pa'i rtogs pa/ hathob bya/ mkha' 'gro ma/ ha gzhi'i yul snang sna tshogs las rab tu rgyal ba/ha dag bya/sgo lnga'i rnam par shes pa/ hadag byed/ gdod ma nas zhi ba/ hathob bya/ mdzes ma/ huṃ= gzhi'i rab tu gdug pa dang mtshon yul 'joms pa/huṃ dag bya/tshor ba las gyur pa'i bde ba/ huṃdag byed/ gang gis kyang 'dus ma byas pa/ huṃthob bya/ dum skyes ma/ hūm̐ gzhi'i mi sdug pa dang ngan pa sel ba/hūm̐ dag bya/tshor ba las gyur pa'i sdug bsngal/ hūm̐dag byed/ yang dag pa'i mtha' las 'das pa/ hūm̐thob bya/gzugs can ma/ phaṭ gzhi'i kun tu sbyor ba'i bag chags spong ba rnams so// phaṭ dag bya/tshor ba las gyur ba'i btang snyoms/ phaṭdag byed*/chos kyi dbyings rnam kun mchog ldan/ phaṭthob bya/dpa' bo dang dpa' mo'i tshogs so// phyi rol rnam dag dang sbyar ba bdun phrag dang po/ phyi rol rnam dag dang sbyar ba bdun phrag gnyis pa/ phyi rol rnam dag dang sbyar ba bdun phrag gsum pa ste phyi'i dag pa nyer gcig nang lha dang sbyar ba'i dag pa bdun phrag gcig / dag pa'i yon tan bdun/ dag par byed pa'i thabs bdun/ sngags kyi ngo bo bdun/ oṃ yon tan/ sku gsum gyi bdag nyid/ oṃ thabs/ rang gi snying dbus su sad pa'i ye shes ngo sprod pa/ oṃ ngo bo/ dran pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag bdun/ ma byon sangs rgyas bdun pa rab gsal gyi//

hrīḥ yon tan/ chags pa'i dngos po dang bral ba/ hrīḥ thabs/ chags pa chen po'i yid kyis lus bstan pa/ hrīḥ ngo bo/ chos rab du rnam par 'byed pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag rnam 'khrul paṇa chen shākya shrī la// ha yon tan/ 'khor 'das kyi chos kun la khyab pa/ ha thabs/ bde ba'i ngo bo nam mkha'i rnal 'byor du ngo sprod pa/ ha ngo bo/ brtson 'grus yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag mkha' 'gros nam mkhar sil snyan dkrol ba'i sgrar// ha yon tan/ dngos po dang bral ba'i bde ba chen po'i bdag nyid/ ha thabs/ bde stong lhan skyes kyi dga' ba rab tu rtogs pa/ ha ngo bo/ dga' ba yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag mkha' 'gro dra ba sdom pa'i yi ge bdun// huṃ= yon tan/ ye shes chen po 'bar zhing rab tu'abar ba/ huṃ thabs/ dga' bral gyi dga' ba mngon du byas pa/huṃ ngo ba/ shin tu sbyangs pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag gzhi lam 'bras bu'i dag pa yi ge bdun// hūm̐ yon tan/ bde ba dang stong pa mchog gi rgyud rlan pa/ hūm̐ thabs/ mchog tu dga' ba'i dngos po mthong ba/hūm̐ ngo bo/ ting nge 'dzin yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag phyi nang gzhan gsum nges pa'i gsang don ni// phaṭ yon tan/ de kho na nyid sems su thag gcad pa/ phaṭ thabs/ rab tu dga' ba ting nge 'dzin du rtogs pa/phaṭ ngo bo/ btang snyoms yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag chos kyi grags pas bsdus te go bder bris/ /gzhan yang gsang ba ye shes dang sbyar ba'i dag pa bdun phrag gcig/ de kho na nyid sbyar ba'i dag pa bdun phrag gcig phyi nang gzhan de kho na nyid kun la thun mong du sbyar ba'i dag pa bdun phrag gcig go// sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༄༅// dra ba sdom pa'i yi ge bdun gyi rnam par bshad pa bzhugs so//
